title: Kalaam : Anjuman e Asghari
body:
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
Nabi ke noore ain Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
Ali ke dil ke chain Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
1. Tu faqre karbala, Tu ibne murtaza(a.s)
Tu deen ki pana'h tu shaahe Ambiya
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu shahe Mashraqain Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Sitam Har ek saha, par uff nahi kiya
sar apna dediya, you'n dee'n bacha liya
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
Luta ke apna chain Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hai tegh hath me, layee'n hai seene pe
hai maa bhi sath me, na qatl kar ise
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
The Fatima(s.a) ke bain Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Wo Shaam aagai, Ghareebi chagayi
you'n tanha hogai, Ali(a.s) ki laadli
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
Na soyi saari rain Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hai bhari bediyaa'n, aur uspa saqtiyaa'n
wo shaam ki galiyaa'n , rasool zadiyaa'n
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
lahu me tar hai nain Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. yateem hogai , Aseer hogai
tumhaari laadli , Sakina(s.a) margai
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
Bapa hai shor o shain Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Baqi banaane ko , diya jalaane ko
sitam mitaane ko , zahoor ab karo
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
aye aaqri Hussain(a.s) Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ye teri
Asghari
, hai teri matami
dikhade aye saqi , wo karbala teri
hai sab ke lab pa bain Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s) - Hussain(a.s) Ya Hussain(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam : Anjuman e Asghari
